summary: Push day. Breakfast is trimmed to three grab-and-go items (pre-sliced turkey, a bagel, berries) since he's skipped it the last couple of days for a shake instead - hopefully quicker to grab. Lunch centers on the Lemongrass Coconut Braised Chicken, the dish he actually grabbed himself yesterday, this time slotted where it fits best. Dinner switches to Achiote Miso Chicken Thigh for variety after two straight days of cod/coconut chicken at dinner.
